 Crash on 10 Freeway between San Dimas and Covina leaves one person dead 
 By City News Service • 
 Published October 23, 2026 • 
 Updated on October 23, 2026 at 6:34 am 
 BOOKMARKER 
 Getty Images/iStockphoto 
 Driver released without charges after Kansas soccer field crash.
 A crash on the 10 Freeway between Covina and San Dimas left one person dead Friday morning.
 The multi-vehicle collision occurred at 3:29 a.m. Friday in eastbound lanes just west of Via Verde Street off-ramp, a California Highway Patrol officer told City News Service.
 Stream Los Angeles News for free, 24/7, wherever you are.
   WATCH HERE 
 First responders pronounced one person dead at the scene.    
 Information regarding what led up to the crash and the name of the person who died were not immediately released.    
 The collision prompted a SigAlert shutting down the left four eastbound lanes.
